title: Retries amplify API timeouts
body: A client retries every timeout immediately, which increases queue pressure during a partial outage. Adding bounded backoff and observing retry volume can keep recovery traffic from overwhelming the service.

title: Schema drift breaks scheduled reports
body: A renamed field in an upstream export caused a downstream report to silently omit records. A contract check at ingestion and an explicit missing-field alert would make this failure visible earlier.

title: Manual handoffs slow incident notes
body: Teams copy incident timestamps between three tools by hand, creating inconsistent timelines. A single structured event record can reduce transcription errors and make later review easier.

title: Local test fixtures expose integration gaps
body: A small fixture suite that covers missing fields and delayed responses caught an adapter mismatch before deployment. Keeping those examples versioned helps reviewers reproduce the edge case.
